item.title: Empire Wind Granted Preliminary Injunction, Construction to Resume
item.description: The underlying lawsuit challenging the U.S. Department of the Interior’s December 22, 2025 suspension order will continue to proceed.Empire Wind will now focus on safely restarting construction activities that were halted during the suspension period.
